title: Unit Conversion I
summary: Given n types of units indexed from 0 to n-1, and a 2D array conversions detailing conversion factors between units, calculate the number of units of each type equivalent to one unit of type 0, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given n types of units indexed from 0 to n-1, and a 2D array conversions detailing conversion factors between units, calculate the number of units of each type equivalent to one unit of type 0, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: There are len(conversions)+1 units and every unit is uniquely reachable from unit 0 along directed conversions.
[source,target,factor] means one source unit equals factor target units.
Return each amount equivalent to one unit 0 modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Unique directed reachability makes every unit’s conversion the product along exactly one path from unit zero.
Traverse outward from unit zero and propagate the current product modulo the fixed modulus.
Set unit zero to one; for each directed edge assign child=parent*factor mod M and visit the child.
Induction on path length proves every assigned value equals its unique root-path factor product.
editorial: Induction on path length proves every assigned value equals its unique root-path factor product.

tests.explanation: Unit zero converts to two unit-one values and then six unit-two values.
Multiplying factors along each unique path gives [1,2,3,8,10,6,30,24].
